reason: Two founders and not a single club live yet; I'm not putting our members through a pilot until I've been able to call Zwolle's board. And even then, at roughly 3,000 euros a year this has to go to the members' meeting, where half the room will say GOLF.NL is free and already does tee times.
objection: What happens to our club if one of those two founders drops out, and how do I explain to the members' meeting why we'd pay for something GOLF.NL largely gives us for free? Our volunteers already have their hands full, and our bar runs on cash and the card machine.
would_change_my_mind: A conversation with the board of Golfclub Zwolle (and preferably a second 9-hole club of our size) after they've been live for at least half a year, showing that their older members actually use it and that it saves the volunteers work.
